liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The River** (1 other source): The River continued from Part III after being left incomplete the previous night [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Wah Wah**: back after 27 archived shows (378 days) [5]
- **Black Tooth**: back after 56 archived shows (644 days); rare: 14 archived performances [5]
- **Dead-Beat**: back after 171 archived shows (1580 days); rare: 11 archived performances [5]
- **Dirt**: back after 51 archived shows (637 days); rare: 10 archived performances [5]
- **The Fourth Colour**: back after 34 archived shows (435 days) [5]
- **Organ Farmer**: back after 43 archived shows (449 days) [5]
- **Road Train**: back after 27 archived shows (378 days) [5]
- **Alien Metal**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 5 archived performances [5]

## The recordings

- **kglw2026-08-15.matrix.flac24** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 176 min [1]. Said about its sound: Hybrid mix uses native audience recordings plus a filtered YouTube layer for front presence [1]
- **kglw2026-08-15.dpa4015.flac24**: source not stated; 23 songs; 176 min [2]
- **kglw2026-08-15.dpa4006.flac24**: source not stated; 23 songs; 176 min [3]
- **kglw2026-08-15.discocape-4channel**: source not stated; 23 songs; 178 min [4]

## Around the show

- This was the first time C guitars were used on stage [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2026-08-15.matrix.flac24**: taped by Brian Porter; Scott Schneider; source: Schoeps MK21 ORTF-wide > Kcy > Sonosax SX-M2/LS2 > Sony M10 (24/96) + DPA 4006C with 30 mm APE spheres AB 60 cm > Sonosax M2D2 AES > Sound Devices 744T (24/96)… [1]
- **kglw2026-08-15.dpa4015.flac24**: taped by Scott Schneider; transferred by Scott Schneider; source: DPA 4015c(NOS/LOC at corner of FOH enclosure/10')->E.A.A. PSP2->SD744T(24bit/96kHz) [2]
- **kglw2026-08-15.dpa4006.flac24**: taped by Scott Schneider; transferred by Scott Schneider; source: DPA 4006c w/30mm APE spheres(AB-60cm/LOC at corner of FOH enclosure/10')->Sonosax M2D2(aes)->SD744T(24bit/96kHz) [3]
- **kglw2026-08-15.discocape-4channel**: taped by discocape; transferred by discocape; source: mk21 + km184 [4]. Also: Discocape tracked and transferred the show, with taping support from Mash and guyforget [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by KGLW.net: [King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard setlist - 2025-08-15 Meadow Creek, Buena Vista, CO, USA](https://kglw.net/setlists/king-gizzard-the-lizard-wizard-august-15-2025-meadow-creek-buena-vista-co-usa.html) [6]
